name: JBS N.V.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: JBS N.V. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 1 Background information: 'The Class A common shares of JBS N.V. are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker symbol "JBS," and its Level II Brazilian Depositary Receipts (BDRs) are traded on B3 under the code "JBSS32"' — the NYSE security is the Class A common share itself, not an ADS
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer flagged ADS_RATIO_MISSING, but JBS N.V. has no ADS program for its NYSE listing: the traded NYSE price is per Class A common share, the same unit as the filing's per-share figures, so the ratio is 1.0 and no scaling applies.

overrides_applied.source: JBS N.V. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-25), Earnings per share note: net income attributable to Company shareholders with 'Weighted average - common shares outstanding' 1,068,508,877 for 2025, 2024 and 2023 (2024/2023 retrospectively adjusted to the 2025 share structure) and a single line 'Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share - (US$)' of 1.89 / 1.65 / (0.19) — basic and diluted use the same denominator
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — DILUTED shares missing for FY2023, 2024, 2025; only WeightedAverageShares is filed. The filer's own EPS note states basic and diluted EPS on that same count (the JBS/Seara share-based plans were cash-settled in those years, with no share issuance for settlement, per the share-based compensation note in the same 20-F), so the filed weighted-average count IS the diluted count for the annual periods. The override fills the diluted slot with the filer's own EPS denominator; it does not replace a different filed diluted value.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (JBS N.V. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Note 1 Background information: 'The Class A common shares of JBS N.V. are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker symbol "JBS," and its Level II Brazilian Depositary Receipts (BDRs) are traded on B3 under the code "JBSS32"' — the NYSE security is the Class A common share itself, not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: JBS N.V. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-25), Earnings per share note: net income attributable to Company shareholders with 'Weighted average - common shares outstanding' 1,068,508,877 for 2025, 2024 and 2023 (2024/2023 retrospectively adjusted to the 2025 share structure) and a single line 'Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per share - (US$)' of 1.89 / 1.65 / (0.19) — basic and diluted use the same denominator); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 19.0x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (8.6%) vs bull-case tier C (13.4%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
